Game Overview

Bob Save Stuart is a two-player title where embark on a daring quest with Bob in a race against eerie purple doom to rescue Stuart. Navigate treacherous territory filled with transformed monsters, collect bananas, and prevent the smoke from taking over. Swift reflexes and smart strategies are key in this thrilling retro escape adventure.
